questions.question_text: A company must recover a deleted Azure VM backup item within the retention window. What protects the backup item from immediate deletion?

question_data.scenario: An administrator accidentally removed a protected VM from backup. Backup data should remain recoverable for a short period.
question_data.instructions: Read the scenario, then select the best answer.

options.label: A
options.text: Soft delete for Recovery Services vaults

options.label: B
options.text: A resource lock on the VM only

questions.explanation: Soft delete retains deleted backup items for a configured period so they can be recovered or undeleted.
